df['d'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Ngày giao dịch'], errors='coerce')
df['gi'] = pd.to_datetime(df['Giờ'], errors='coerce')

# revenue statuses: đã xong, đã lấy
rev_status = ['đã xong','đã lấy']
df_rev = df[df['Status'].isin(rev_status)].copy()

# filter week 2026-03-02 .. 2026-03-08
w = (df_rev['d']>=pd.Timestamp('2026-03-02')) & (df_rev['d']<=pd.Timestamp('2026-03-08'))

def shift(t):

    if 6<=h<=13: return 'sáng'
    if 14<=h<=21: return 'chiều'
    return 'khac'
dfw['sh']=dfw['gi'].apply(shift)

print(dfw['sh'].value_counts())
print("total revenue week", dfw['val'].sum())

# by shift
tbl=dfw.groupby('sh')['val'].sum()
print(tbl)

sáng=tbl.get('sáng',0); chiều=tbl.get('chiều',0)
